rationale: The stock has already gapped down ~23% on earnings miss and negative comp-store sales, and at 58 minutes to close with price sitting at 27% of today's range and below VWAP ($49.34), the directional edge is unclear — a late-day bounce attempt is stalling (last candle closed lower at $48.30 after reaching $48.55), while a short faces the risk of a relief squeeze into close. The ATR of ~$0.29 on 5-minute bars offers very tight reward relative to the noise in a post-earnings, high-relative-volume tape, and with today already showing a small realized loss, the risk/reward does not justify committing capital in either direction.
